correctness.rationale: Exact Gram inverse gives the reproducing kernel. The endpoint total-variation calculation and small-frequency uniform O(r^2) row-kernel estimate reduce to a confluent rank-two projector whose global norm is exactly 8/e by a full three-region proof. High-frequency uniform averaging of absolute cosine gives 8/pi+O(1/r). The rank-one b=0 projector has norm 2. Finite checks are supplementary only. The original-basis Gram trace and determinant give the separate condition-number asymptotic 4/r^2.

value.rationale: The natural rank-two damped modal least-squares projector has exact and distinct sharp uniform-norm constants in the nearly coalescent and high-frequency limits, plus an endpoint evaluation formula. The 8/e versus 2 jump at exact rank collapse isolates a genuine stability issue; coefficient conditioning diverges while output amplification remains controlled. This yields a motivated boundary law rather than an arbitrary finite evaluation. The precise Gram condition-number divergence 4/r^2 versus bounded projection gain strengthens the interpretation of this conditioning boundary.
